name: name-with-digits
about: A campaign's name carries digits (a year, a radius) that are the advertiser's words, not figures.

output.headline: 2 campaigns spent $219.50 on November 3, 2026, delivering 5 leads at $43.90 each across 11,850 impressions.
points: CDL-A 2026 Joliet 75mi drove all 5 leads at $30.68 each on $153.40 spend, 8,800 impressions, and a 1.4% click rate. Team drivers I-80 spent $66.10 across 3,050 impressions with a 1.0% click rate but no leads yet, so no cost per lead.
Month to date in November 2026, Meta has taken $487.00 of spend with 28 days left in the month.
The 2026-09-28 cohort (40 leads) shows 36 contacted, 20 made applicants, 12 applied, 5 hired, and 9 lost after conversion — the strongest hire rate of the mature cohorts at 12.5%.
The 2026-09-21 cohort (38 leads) shows 33 contacted, 17 made applicants, 10 applied, 4 hired, and 8 lost after conversion, for a 10.5% hire rate.
The 2026-10-26 cohort has 12 leads with 9 contacted, 3 made applicants, 1 applied, and 1 lost after conversion — it is too young to judge rates yet.
No lead quality data was recorded over the last 14 days for either campaign.
